## Every value belongs to exactly one class {#l3-class-boundaries}

Keep $x=13$. Change which endpoint is included.
```{=html}
<div data-module="boundary"></div>
```

::: {.takeaway}
No gaps. No overlaps. A clear boundary convention.
:::

::: notes
Start at $x=13$. With lower endpoints included, it belongs to $13\text{–}<14$. Switch to upper endpoints included: it belongs to $12>\text{–}13$. A value such as 13.1 stays between 13 and 14 in either convention.

The slider ranges from 11.1 to 14.9 so every available value belongs to one of the four displayed classes under either convention. These are exact numerical intervals; rounding physical measurements is a separate recording issue.
:::
